name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast for all interactive elements. This ensures keyboard users see clear focus without strain, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA for focus visibility while keeping the ring thick enough for touch and low-vision users. The trade-off is slightly more visual weight, but it’s necessary to avoid missing focus entirely on high-contrast or small screens.

name: Reader
text: Risk: The 4px ring at 7:1 contrast fails when users toggle *both* reduced motion *and* high-contrast mode—it disappears into the background. Better alternative: a 3px ring at 4.5:1 contrast with a 1px outer glow at 7:1, ensuring visibility in all modes. Settle by testing in both modes on real devices.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt a 3px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast with a 1px outer glow at 7:1 contrast for all interactive elements. This ensures visibility in both normal and high-contrast modes while honoring reduced-motion preferences, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA for focus visibility without overpowering the interface. The trade-off is a slightly thinner ring in standard mode, but the glow compensates, keeping clarity for all users.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring at 4.5:1 risks blending into busy backgrounds when users toggle high-contrast mode—it’s too thin to stand out. A 4px ring at 7:1 contrast with a 1px outer glow at 4.5:1 keeps visibility in all modes without relying on fragile contrast swaps. Settle by testing on real devices in both high-contrast and reduced-motion modes.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Use a 3px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with a 0.5px inset shadow for all interactive elements. Result: A tested, high-contrast focus indicator that works in normal, reduced-motion, and high-contrast modes. Owner: Ramp.
